We need propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O.

We have identified a template (id 29646) that matches target and corresponds to deprotection of TBS? Actually retro template: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]...' This is a protection step: forward is protecting alcohol with TBS. Retro means removing TBS to give alcohol. So step 1 retrosynthesis: target -> precursor where TBS group removed (i.e., replace OSi(tBu)(Me)2 with OH). So we need to apply template 29646 to target to get precursor(s). Use apply_template.
